
This file maintains a directory listing of the NoRedist folder which contains
external libraries that are generally free for anyone to download and use,
but are not redistributable by Epic. Also included are instructions for
acquiring these tools yourself.

NoRedist\Apsalar

	This SDK is used for analytics and can be downloaded from the Apsalar website http://www.apsalar.com/
	
NoRedist\Swrve

	This SDK is used for analytics and can be downloaded from the Swrve website when you have started your trial.
	Your Swrve account managers will provide the information needed (currently the files are swrve.c/h).
